messages:
jia: Quick note: prototype for scrubber preview + sampling is up: https://www.figma.com/file/gh1. Observed UX confusion during demo.
marco: saw it. what's the confusion?
jia: when sampling is on the scrubber numeric p95 looks unstable and users assume it's the true value.
emma: can we prepend a tiny sr-only prefix 'estimate' so screen readers immediately call it out?
ryan: agree. visual badge too, but make it visually subtle. propose: small inline pill 'Estimate • 10%' next to value.
aria: accessibility: badge must not be the only indicator. include sr-only full sentence: 'This value is an estimate based on 10% of requests.' Also ensure aria-live announces changes while dragging.
marco: failure mode: toggling sampling while scrubber open causes jump. Plan: animate crossfade and show a transient banner 'Switched to sampled data'. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
emma: copy: short pill text: 'Sampled (10%)'. Tooltip: 'Estimate based on sample. Confidence interval shown when available.'
ryan: dev: backend can return extrapolated_estimate if requested. use that for smoother scrubber preview. fall back to sampled raw value. throttle calls to 250ms.
aria: checklist I'll add: tabbable pill, SR text, live region, reduced-motion, focus contrast >=3:1.
jia: next steps: emma to update copy & figma; ryan to prototype throttle + extrapolated flag; aria to post a11y checklist. Reconvene tomorrow. :thumbsup: 
hookbot: Reminder queued: accessibility pass scheduled for next sprint.
